TEXT.English: Yo, dude! I'm [OUR_NAME]! Glad to meet you, [CT_NAME]! Do you love music and culture just as much as I do? We'll be fast friends if we can get along...
Dude, that isn't happenin' anytime soon. Not after the stunt you pulled... Talk about bein' uncool! I need you to stay away for a little while, okay?
Alright, dude. I'm glad to hear you will respect our differences. Keeping the peace between us is the best plan ever!
Dude, no way. Nothin' doin'! I'm pretty ticked off at your uncool behavior... You're seriously crashing my party here. Leave!
Dude, how's everything goin' for you? Feels like we haven't talked in forever, you know! Do you need some help or do you just wanna chat with me?
Dude, like, this better be a good use of my time... Otherwise, you should make like a drum and beat it!
Dude, like, these nuclear weapons sure are ultra-powerful. Hurt my friends and you'll get a very close and personal look at them, got that [CT_NAME]?
Dude, I could really use your help here! Whatcha say to giving this to me, like, right now? I can totally pay you back later, ya know...
Dude, how ya holding up? Me, I'm sorta in a bind here... I hope you can help me out! I think this'll help both of us get what we want, you know. Maybe I can help you out in the future, huh?

Dude, I sure would appreciate it if someone trusthworthy could help a girl out... I haven't been able to keep up with the latest trends, unfortunately! How's about ya bring me up to speed with this trade deal?
Dude, I would really appreciate it if someone trusthworthy could help a girl out ASAP...
Dude, I could really use your help here! Whatcha say to giving me a gift, like, ASAP?
Dude, can I ask you for a bit of assistance in my time of need? Please consider my little request, ASAP!
Dude, I see that you appear to be in a bit of a bind right now... I'll be glad to help you out, buddy! This way, we can both get what we want, you know!
Dude, it's not cool to have your friends worrying about you. Friends don't let their friends down, you know! Why don't you accept this gift? I'm sure it'll really help you.
I hope you'll like this tribute, [CT_NAME]. As your good friend, I'm always happy to help you out! Will you take this?
This is my final offer, dude. It's the best I can do right now!
I wanna end this conflict, dude... It's really put me in a bind here! Do you think this is a good enough peace deal?
Here's a deal you might like, dude. How about it?
Sorry, dude! I no longer want this deal anymore, so I'm gonna stop it now. If you still need this trade, feel free to show me another offer.
Dude, totally not cool! You need to stop right now. My friends and I will not let you get away with this! ([OUR_NAME] declares war!)
